This is the second meeting  of the budget review process in the City. This will be a workshop meeting. At the last meeting the council only reviewed the school budget. 

Below are my preliminary thoughts and initial positions going into the meeting. Please email me at <sjacobson@franklinnh.gov> if you would like to discuss further.

------------------------------------------------------------------
## Agenda Items


## 1. Budget Presentations
Throughout the month of June, the City Council will be discussing the City Manager's proposed budget line-by-line. This is a chance for the City Council to see where the City Manager wants to spend money. 

This meeting will cover the following: 

 - Fire
 - Police
 - City Manager's Office
